title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/FlagMeasures): deduplicate AmplitudeAbsolutelyConvergentOperatorNormLe via AmplitudeDegenerateOperatorNormLeRealPlace
body:
`AmplitudeAbsolutelyConvergentOperatorNormLe.lean` already imports `AmplitudeDegenerateOperatorNormLeRealPlace.lean`, which proves more general `j ≤ r` versions of the minor/Gram majorant bound (`GlobalTheory.Amp.MinorBound.minor_gram_bound`) and two-flag Gram-minor bound (`GlobalTheory.Amp.ExtPow.bound_of_split`), as well as the shared dyadic summation helpers (`dyad_cauchySchwarz`, `dyad_exists_down`, `dyad_tsum_four`) and `DegConv` subgroup-extension/quotient helpers. This PR removes the duplicated `j = r` proofs and helper copies in `AmplitudeAbsolutelyConvergentOperatorNormLe.lean` and reuses those declarations directly.

- Removed duplicated `GlobalTheory.Dyadic` helpers: `lintegral_mul_le_of_sq`, `exists_shell_down`, `tsum_four`.
- Removed duplicated `GlobalTheory.Amp.YBound` declarations: `det_upper`, `det_change`, `prod_le_pow'`, `formE`, `formE_apply`, `formE_le`, `herm_mulVec`, `gramProj_le`, `dr_y_le`.
- Removed duplicated `GlobalTheory.Amp.LemA` declarations: `herm_add_l`, `herm_add_r`, `herm_smul_l`, `herm_smul_r`, `herm_sum_l`, `herm_sum_r`, `herm_conj`, `herm_isom`, `cs_real`, `herm_cs`, `inner_eq_herm`, `hpk_herm`, `hpk_unit`, `hpk_mulVec_e`, `herm_e`, `herm_e_e`, `herm_low`, `semidef`, `Zm`, `Dr_eq`, `inv_cancel`, `herm_inv`, `Zm_inv`, `decomp`, `fvec_cast`, `alg`, `herm_self_norm`, `form_bound`, `gramProj_eq`, `Yv_mul_Yv_mul_Dr_le`.
- Removed duplicated `GlobalTheory.Amp.AbsConv` declarations: `lmul_inv_lmul`, `lmulEquiv`, `quot_map`, `ext0`, `cochainExtendByZeroSubgroup_of_mem`, `amplifierAbsConvExtendByZero_of_not_mem`, `measurable_amplifierAbsConvExtendByZero` (and made the internal helper `GlobalTheory.Amp.AbsConv.side` private).
